loss: Average absolute error over observed horizons within each CVE, then average CVEs; no group weighting or target imputation.
selection: Earliest strictly lowest validation per-CVE observed-horizon mean MAE from epoch 1. Report each horizon separately and all seeds.
history_policy: Recompute masks and observation age inside each visible window. No carry from earlier excluded days. Require at least one observation in every compared window.
limitations: This is a new joint three-output task, not a pure gain/loss ablation against single-output GV01 or GB01.
The parent cohort already requires an observed Day-60 score; shorter-horizon coverage is conditional on that selection.
Fixed chronological CVE roles are inherited; they do not guarantee independence of related vulnerability families.
Daily score dates do not establish exact release times or recover FIRST's daily predictor features.
Validation has informed prior development and is not independent final evaluation.
No adaptive window selection, daily trajectory, rolling anchors, TPG fusion or test scoring in this stage.
